description:
## Goal

Repair the draft stack so every retained PR, branch, and commit names one atomic change before the runtime-intrinsic cutover is reworked. The old #148 bundled fz-5xp.30, fz-kdt.22, and fz-tfn.67 under a .30-only title.

## Resulting graph

`gh stack` #155 is the exact retained graph:

`main -> #128 -> #131 -> #132 -> #133 -> #134 -> #135 -> #136 -> #137 -> #147`

Each PR has exactly its one ticket commit and exact direct base. The retained heads were replayed locally, conflicts were resolved against merged def/defp semantics with focused tests, and `gh stack submit` force-with-lease pushed all retained branches together and rewired bases. The initial root #128 CI was green before submission; because stack-base rewiring requires a coherent remote graph, later retained heads were submitted together rather than waiting for unavailable intermediate CI. Final acceptance requires fresh CI green for every rewritten head.

## Removed layers

- #129 is superseded by merged #146/#150/#151 named-fn removal.
- #138/fz-5xp.81 is rejected: its clause expansion raises causal work, weakens a less-work gate, adds duplicate algorithm authorities, unreachable repair arms, and raw-text authority. Its two measured hypotheses belong only in fz-5xp.85.
- #139/fz-5xp.93 is rejected as an expansion. Reopened .93 owns deletion of unused slicing scaffold, erased callback shape, and related specialization surface.
- Old #148/.30 is rejected: it adds intrinsic syntax and duplicate semantic authorities. Reopened fz-5xp.30 owns a fresh one-authority design; safety refs retain .22/.67 for later truthful descendants.

#129/#138/#139/#148 are closed, absent from stack #155, and their remote branches are deleted only after their descendants were reparented. Local safety refs retain every old head.

## Safety evidence

- Frozen fz-tfn.62 remains unchanged: `git diff HEAD --binary` SHA-256 is `d9fc8631dbcb676f78a760c44ada7f63bff74edb60a13b9b52741db7321b7458`.
- The repair clone is clean. Retained range diffs show only expected named-definition migration/conflict adaptations.
- #131 was closed/reopened solely to trigger CI for its already-published new head; its branch, direct base, one-commit boundary, and ready-for-review state are unchanged.

## Acceptance before close

- Stack #155, remote heads, PR bases, single-commit boundaries, safety refs, dropped branches, and frozen .62 fingerprint remain as above.
- Fresh CI is green for every rewritten retained head, including #131.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold review finds no remaining graph, boundary, lease, deletion, or frozen-worktree defect.
- No source implementation, compatibility path, main rewrite, or construction debris is introduced by this stack repair.
## Current-main replay

A fresh cold review found two retained-range omissions in the first replay: #128 had restored an obsolete JSON-key rationale despite its singleton scalar-key oracle, and #147 had revived a false allocator-sensitive implementation diary. The repair amended only those existing ticket commits: #128 restores the accurate binary-key/singleton-key explanation; #147 deletes the diary rather than pinning allocation counts or rendered function identities. Their focused three-door fixtures pass.

While that repair was in flight, `main` advanced to `14fc8845` (#156). #156 moves expensive coverage to pushes on main and gives PRs the fast full correctness suite. The entire retained one-commit chain was replayed cleanly onto that exact main head, with the repaired trees preserved. Format, strict Clippy, and `RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 cargo test --workspace --all-features -- --quiet` pass at the rebased tip. The old full-coverage #131 run was cancelled once it became obsolete. Fresh PR CI for all nine current-main heads is the final pending gate.

Current remote graph remains `main@14fc8845 -> #128 -> #131 -> #132 -> #133 -> #134 -> #135 -> #136 -> #137 -> #147`; each PR remains ready, has one direct ticket commit, and has the same tree as the locally verified replay. Additional `safety/tfn69/main-rebase-pre-*` refs preserve the pre-current-main repaired heads.
title: Rebuild #148 as a truthful stack before the intrinsic cutover
